public_api.name: Router
public_api.signature: Router(store, allowed_users, username, *, max_pending=4, acknowledge=None, voice_enabled=False, media=None)
public_api.purpose: Authorize and queue text/voice requests; preserve command and pairing behavior.

public_api.name: CommandRunner
public_api.signature: CommandRunner(project, state_dir, *, store=None, skip_git_repo_check=False, model=None, profile=None, search=False, skills=(), chat_style=False, media=None, speech=None)
public_api.purpose: Use existing exact native session/executor; prepare selected media and optional speech.

public_api.name: MediaOutbox
public_api.signature: MediaOutbox(workspace, state_dir); prepare(job_id, manifest); add_voice(job_id, content); record_voice_request(job_id, job, *, reuse=False); voice_mode(job); deliver(job, api, *, authorized)
public_api.purpose: Persist voice intent, bounded media snapshots and upload progress separately from Telegram jobs.

public_api.name: OpenAISpeech
public_api.purpose: Injectable optional OpenAI speech generation returning MP3.

public_api.name: BotService
public_api.signature: BotService(api, store, router, runner, *, poll_timeout=10, transport=None, media=None)
public_api.purpose: Reuse existing worker; deliver stable text and media with authorization checks.

public_api.name: BotAPI.send_photo
public_api.purpose: Upload bounded local photo bytes with generic filename.

public_api.name: BotAPI.send_voice
public_api.purpose: Upload bounded MP3 voice with AI disclosure.

commands: Telegram /voice QUESTION: one spoken answer plus text
Telegram /voice: read the latest successful answer in this private chat
Telegram text request: generate/select images for actual photo attachment

inputs: job mapping with id and prompt; optional existing chat/user fields
outputs: status succeeded or failed and response text; exact native session retained

storage.namespace: Bot/project outputs Telegram state; media.sqlite3 and media/<job>/ snapshots separate from jobs DB
storage.migration_notes: Additive independent uploads and voice_requests tables in media.sqlite3; existing Telegram jobs/users/sessions/cursors and text delivery_snapshots retained. No legacy data deletion.

limitations: Live image generation, Telegram uploads/playback and speech API authorization/quality not tested.
PNG/JPEG images in configured outputs only; max 4, 10 MiB each.
Speech max 4000 characters and 10 MiB; missing speech config/failure falls back to text.
Crash between remote send and local cursor save may duplicate an item.
No incoming voice transcription or media resend through /result; Discord deferred.
delivery_scope: Telegram image attachments and explicit outbound /voice replies; Discord deferred.
external_services: Optional OpenAI Speech API: local SENAI_TTS_API_KEY (fallback OPENAI_API_KEY), API billing, default gpt-4o-mini-tts/coral
Installed Codex built-in image generation when available; no image API client/key added
